title: Hinomori Shizuku — Reaching Out To Something〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: To One Day Reach that Flowery Stage

rows.Line: Shizuku's Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <We need to decide what we'll be doing for our next stream soon.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Yeah. We thankfully have a few good ideas in stock, so it shouldn't take us much time to turn one of those into a proper segment.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Right. But I'm still really sad that you aren't gonna be there for our next livestream, Haruka...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
<Sorry...
A different offer suddenly came in, which now conflicts with this.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <It's okay, Haruka. That's perfectly understandable.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Yeah. Plus, we're not about to make you disappoint the person who helped you get that offer. You gotta make the most of it.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<So, don't worry about us.
We'll take care of everything here.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <I promise to work extra hard in your place, Haruka.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Me too!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Thank you, everyone.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (The four of us haven't been doing as many streams together as we used to lately.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But there's nothing we can do about sudden scheduling changes and such...)

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Hey, where's Minori?>
<Oh, I think she's somewhere else for work today.>
<I was really hoping to see her.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Our viewers are taking the time to watch our streams, so I'd rather not disappoint them like that...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (The way we work may have changed, but our feelings haven't.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (My hope is that we'll be able to get that message across to our viewers.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
<Oh, Haruka.
Since you're not gonna be available, what if you prepared a little message for your fans?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<That's a good idea.
We could even use it as a talking point.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Hehe. I don't mind you all doing that, but it may depend on what you're talking about.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Use her absence as a talking point...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <I know...!>

rows.Speaker: Minori & Airi
rows.Line:
<Eep!>
<Huh?!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <I'm so sorry! I didn't mean to shout...!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <That's okay. It sounded like a lightbulb flashed above your head. Mind telling us your idea?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Yes, it did!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <So, during our next livestream...>
A few days later
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hello, everyone♪
It's time for another MORE MORE JUMP! livestream!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Airi
rows.Line: Yay♪

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Hello!>
<Finally!>
<Hi, first-time viewer here!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, it looks like we have some first-time viewers with us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, let's start by introducing ourselves to them! Take it away, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Don't give up on your dreams, Minorinrin♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Here's a bouquet of hope for you!
I'm Minori Hanasato from MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ahem...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No matter how far, may this song of hope reach you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm Haruka Kiritani from MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, don't give me that look...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You're so full of energy today, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Wait, what?!
You're totally missing the point!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Argh! I have to do everything myself because you're not around, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Airi's also full of energy today!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Because a certain someone isn't here today!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, as we said in our notice for this stream, Haruka's elsewhere for work today.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Which means I have to double cover for her by coming up with even more quips than usual! So, everyone, wish me luck!!!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<That sounds really hard, but also fun.>
<You can do it, Airi!>
<We believe in you!!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks, you guys...!
I promise to do my best!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm so happy for you, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, also.
Haruka provided us with a little message—

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, you gotta introduce yourself first!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, you're right.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Wow, she really does have to work overtime today.>
<Please, stop! My sides!>
<This is turning into an instant classic.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I lost focus for a second there, but Airi's doing such an incredible job for us already...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (We need to keep doing our best in order to make sure our viewers don't feel disappointed about Haruka being absent!)
